raw_response:
Most likely diagnosis: Systemic lupus erythematosus.

The findings supporting this are: inflammatory polyarthritis, photosensitive malar rash and oral ulcers, ana positive with leukopenia. However, the picture is not entirely specific and other causes remain possible.

Other possibilities to consider include parvovirus b19 arthropathy, rheumatoid arthritis, undifferentiated connective tissue disease.

Recommendation: confirm the diagnosis with the appropriate investigations, start guideline-based management and arrange senior review.
